input.text: Product turntable video on a pure white seamless studio background. The first image is the starting frame. The camera performs one single smooth, constant-speed, full 360 degree orbit around the weighing station, ending exactly at the starting view so it can loop. The station stays perfectly centered, same size, same height and same soft studio lighting for the whole video. The product design must not change at any angle: white column scale with stainless tray and blue keypad panel, black tablet on a black articulated arm, black charging hub with a cable. Keep the tablet screen black. No text added, no people, no hands, no shadows on the floor, no music, no speech.
